svg.text: The closure drain reads liveness under the same gate
One pointer, three runs: the drain row is what a session reads to decide whether it may close.

Measured: the foreign rows read process_alive true at the base revision and stop doing so at the repair,
while the local row reads process gone, proven, in both arms.
